study.hypothesis: The fixed zero direction may be a restrictive orientation for rank15 item embeddings under inherited scorer/tower weights and elementwise target-key interactions. Let e_f(x)=[z_f(x), dot(w_f,z_f(x))], with z_f a learned15-coordinate lookup and w_f initially zero. Learning only the added direction can improve compatibility with the inherited width16 interaction operator without restoring a per-ID sixteenth free coordinate. Rank remains at most15 per field. This is a testable representation/reparameterization hypothesis; any observed benefit could also come from optimization or numerical effects, and does not establish that the removed original coordinate is reconstructed.

Provisional quality retention additionally requires AUC at least contemporaneous full16 minus0.0001 and no click Logloss increase greater than0.0001. No equivalence/noninferiority statistical claim follows from this threshold or one seed.

Joint practical efficiency requires at least4% fewer persistent parameters and at least5% lower measured model-only p50 AND p95 whole-batch latency versus contemporaneous full16 at8192. Also report loader-inclusive inference time/throughput and train cost: parameter savings alone do not meet the cost prediction.
